prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want me to pull up current shops and prices for you? Before I look anything up, a couple quick questions so I recommend the right places:
- What vehicle (make/model/year) and tire size (e.g. 225/45R17) or OEM tire?
- Any brand(s) you prefer (Michelin, Bridgestone, Goodyear, Continental, etc.)?
- Budget (economy, mid‑range, premium) and whether you have a Costco membership?
- Do you need same‑day install or any special services (run‑flat, TPMS service, road‑force balancing, alignment)?

General guidance for Pleasanton area tires and installation
- Where to buy (good options)
  - Discount Tire/Tire Rack installers: usually very competitive on price, big inventory, fast installs.
  - Firestone Complete Auto Care / Goodyear / Pep Boys: national chains with convenient service centers and warranties; often bundle mounting, balancing, and lifetime rotations.
  - Costco Tire Center (Dublin area): excellent pricing and warranty if you have a membership; can be busy but great value.
  - Local independent tire shops: often give personalized service and can be more flexible on price or fitting nonstandard wheels. Worth checking local reviews.

- How to choose the best installer
  - Equipment & services: ask if they do road‑force balancing, TPMS programming, and computerized alignments if needed.
  - Price transparency: confirm mounting, balancing, valve stems, disposal fee, and taxes upfront.
  - Turnaround and appointments: same‑day? loaner cars? how long the job will take?
  - Warranties & perks: prorated treadwear warranties, free rotations, puncture repairs, road hazard coverage.
  - Reviews & ratings: check Google and Yelp for recent customer posts about installs and service quality.

- My practical recommendation
  1. Get 2–3 quotes (chain vs local) for the exact tire model/size you want.
  2. Ask each place whether they include road‑force balancing, TPMS service, alignment check, and disposal fees.
  3. If you value speed and low price → Discount Tire or Costco (if member). If you value bundled services and national warranty → Firestone/Pep Boys. If you want personalized attention and possibly better negotiation → a well‑reviewed independent shop.

If you want, I’ll look up current top‑rated tire sellers and installers in Pleasanton and compare prices/appointment availability — tell me your car and tire size (or allow me to find them from the car).
